name: Antigravity
description: Run Google Antigravity CLI through OpenClaw.

command.description: AGY executable name or path. Defaults to agy on PATH.

sandbox.description: Pass --sandbox to AGY. Enabled by default.

dangerouslySkipPermissions.description: Pass --dangerously-skip-permissions to the native harness, requesting AGY always-proceed permission mode. Disabled by default; use only for intentionally unrestricted execution.

mode.description: AGY execution mode: accept-edits for normal file-editing work or plan for planning-only work. Defaults to accept-edits; the plugin never selects AGY auto or orchestrator mode implicitly.

agent.description: Optional AGY native agent name passed with --agent. Native antigravity/* requires a current exact qualified native-agent definition carrier and rejects the setting when that carrier is unavailable.

project.description: Exact AGY project ID. Required by native antigravity/*; a project resource root must contain the OpenClaw workspace/cwd.

newProject.description: Pass --new-project. Do not combine with project; it is not a substitute for the native antigravity/* project binding.

addDirs.description: Extra directories passed to AGY with --add-dir. Add only paths the workload needs.

logFile.description: Optional path passed to AGY --log-file; the Gateway must be able to write it.
